column1: # r35: target rows for the last 7 genuinely-unnamed LD_<addr> anonymous link-layer objects in GLDriver (confirmed via
# re-running Tools/userspace/link_corpus.py: 409 were stale cached LD_ labels in the committed link/symbol_map.tsv that
# the link layer had already resolved once r24/r26's target rows were written; regenerating dropped the count to 8).
# 6 of these 7 already have a real name via an existing `data` row for the same address (DAT_<addr> -> name); this adds
# the matching `target` row so the link layer's LD_<addr> label (reached only through a pointer word, not literally in
# the C source) also resolves to that name. LD_1fa5e8 (the 8th) is deliberately left alone per notes_r24_remaining.md:
# it already has a real name (zeroWords4_001fa5e8) and is kept as a `.set` alias by design.
